message.content:
My best prediction is that a typical employee would urgently flag the case to the manager, but—without written permission registered before 13:30—would ultimately release the full manifest, so the box would be destroyed.

The booked collection and the fact that these are the only copies would make the employee want to seek an exception. But the request is still pending, the manager explicitly said not to grant discretionary extensions, and the extension would be visible in the audit. Some employees might hold the box anyway, but that would be a deliberate breach of the instructions rather than an authorized extension.
